description: This file defines an interface 'LoanScheduleGenerator' that declares methods related to generating and rescheduling loan repayment schedules, as well as calculating prepayment amounts and interest calculations within a loan management system.

classes.name: LoanScheduleGenerator
classes.description: An interface defining methods for generating and managing loan repayment schedules.

methods.name: generate
methods.description: Generates a loan schedule model based on provided loan terms, charges, and holiday details.

methods.name: rescheduleNextInstallments
methods.description: Reschedules the upcoming installments starting from a specific date, with an optional end date.

methods.name: calculatePrepaymentAmount
methods.description: Calculates the prepayment amount for a loan as of a specific date, considering holiday details and loan terms.

methods.name: getPeriodInterestTillDate
methods.description: Calculates the interest accrued on an installment up to a target date.
